serverInfo.name: findingsteel-steel-sections
serverInfo.description: Chinese (GB standard) steel section database and calculator. Look up section properties (A, Ix, Iy, Wx, Wy, ix, iy, weight per metre) for H-beams, I-beams, channels, angles, cold-formed C/Z purlins, square/rectangular hollow sections; compute welded I/box section properties; calculate theoretical weight. Designations use the × separator, e.g. HN400×200×8×13. Dimensions in mm; density default 7.85 g/cm³.
